description: OVERVIEW: Write-Back is a SaaS Power BI Custom Visual that enables users to submit data directly from a Power BI report to your database, allowing to implement any actionable use case without leaving the analysis flow. Write-Back for Power BI is a no-code solution. Unlike Power Apps, creating actionable use cases with Write-Back does not require development teams. This means you can implement and manage interactive data entry, editing, and feedback processes directly within Power BI dashboards, streamlining workflows and empowering business users without the need for coding expertise. To request a trial in a private environment and start using the product tailored to your specific needs, click on "Buy Now", follow the standard subscription process, and take advantage of the 30-day free trial. If you prefer to explore Write-Back quickly and easily, you can use our Public Demo Environment. Just follow the instructions available here. For any questions, please contact us at support@writeback4analytics.com MAIN FEATURES: User Collaboration Write-Back turns Power BI into a truly collaborative tool, allowing users to interact seamlessly within dashboards. From real-time data input to notifications, mentions, and approval workflows, it helps teams manage complex business processes without ever leaving Power BI.
